verdict.rationale: Elicit documents exports in open formats: the Library as .ris for Zotero, Mendeley or EndNote, tables as CSV/Excel, source tables as RIS/BIB, and research reports as PDF/DOCX. However, exporting Systematic Review tables is limited to Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans, and nothing shows a single complete account export. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-wide export covering all data (sessions, chats, projects, skills, columns), export of Systematic Review tables on every plan, account deletion and offboarding guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation that exports are complete.
